story.title: Magellanic Cloud and Rayonix Tech Form Rs 100-Crore JV With Israel's Xtend to Make Drones in India
story.summary: Indian technology firms Magellanic Cloud and Rayonix Tech have announced a Rs 100-crore joint venture with Israeli drone technology company Xtend to manufacture advanced unmanned aerial vehicles in India. The JV aims to meet India's growing demand for sophisticated drones, with the first production-ready drone sets expected within four to six months. The initiative aligns with India's Make in India push for defence and dual-use technology self-reliance, reducing dependence on imported UAV systems.
